description: This file contains configuration utilities and constants for the 'acpx' plugin, including functions to resolve plugin root directories, parse plugin configurations, and generate commands for plugin installation and server setup.

methods.name: isAcpxPluginRoot
methods.description: Checks if a directory contains the necessary files to be considered an 'acpx' plugin root.

methods.name: resolveNearestAcpxPluginRoot
methods.description: Finds the nearest plugin root directory up to three levels above the current module URL.

methods.name: resolveWorkspaceAcpxPluginRoot
methods.description: Resolves the plugin root within a workspace if the directory structure matches expected patterns.

methods.name: resolveAcpxPluginRoot
methods.description: Determines the plugin root directory, preferring the workspace root if applicable.

methods.name: buildAcpxLocalInstallCommand
methods.description: Generates an npm install command string for a specific 'acpx' version.

methods.name: formatAcpxConfigIssue
methods.description: Formats a zod validation issue into a human-readable string.

methods.name: parseAcpxPluginConfig
methods.description: Parses and validates raw plugin configuration data.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredCommand
methods.description: Resolves the command path for the plugin, considering absolute paths and relative configurations.

methods.name: resolveOpenClawRoot
methods.description: Resolves the root directory of the 'openclaw' project based on current directory structure.

methods.name: resolvePluginToolsMcpServerConfig
methods.description: Resolves the configuration for the plugin tools MCP server, choosing between built and source scripts.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredMcpServers
methods.description: Resolves the MCP server configurations, adding reserved server if pluginToolsMcpBridge is true.

methods.name: toAcpMcpServers
methods.description: Converts MCP server configuration objects into an array of MCP server instances with environment variables.

methods.name: resolveAcpxPluginConfig
methods.description: Resolves and validates the complete plugin configuration, setting defaults and generating commands.
